rationale: As the assigning justice and an originalist focused on the general-warrant/sequencing defect at step one, Justice Thomas is best positioned to write a majority holding that geofence warrants lacking ex ante particularity and individualized probable cause are unreasonable searches. Separate writings are most likely from Justice Gorsuch (property- and text-focused elaboration) and Justice Sotomayor (privacy/chilling-effects emphasis), with the Chief Justice or Justice Kavanaugh likely to write a fact-bound dissent defending staged narrowing and “as specific as practicable” particularity.
